title: Ethereal Technologies
description: Welcome to a world where magic and technology merge together.
body:
**At the moment, the build is under development and it is not optimized enough!**


**Welcome to a world where magic and technology merge together**. This build transforms Minecraft into a space where ancient rituals are juxtaposed with automated workshops, and the stars are available for exploration — but not without dangers.

Hex Casting magic and rituals are combined with Create mechanics and automation. Explore space through Ad Astra, battle the dangers of The Undergarden, and in between, build machinery and learn spells.

**Build for those who like to explore, build mechanisms and immerse themselves in magic — all in one world.**

What's inside

**_Magic and rituals_**

• Hex Casting is a full—fledged magic system with spell customization

• Hex-Ars Linker — connects magic with technology

• Hexalia — a world full of magical creatures and artifacts

• Ender's Delight, Ocean's Delight, Ratatouille — recipes inspired by magic and nature

• XP Tome — a book of experience, so as not to lose the accumulation

**_Technomechanics_**

• Create and its add—ons - from cannons to automated mines

• Create Big Cannons, Create Ore Excavation, Create: Deep Dark — large-scale mechanisms

• Farmer's Delight, Farmer's Delight Refabricated — farm automation

• MEGA Cells — energy and resource storage facilities

**_Space and adventure_**

• Ad Astra, Ad Astra: Planets+ — flight to the stars, new planets, alien biomes

• The Undergarden — an underground world with a unique atmosphere

• Citadel — ruins full of mysteries

• GraveStone Mod — dangerous locations and ancient burials

**_Navigation and discovery_**

• Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's World Map — detailed maps

• Explorer's Compass, Nature's Compass — orientation in the world

• Waystones — teleportation between points

• Advancement Plaques, Patchouli — a system of achievements and knowledge books

**_Visual and atmosphere_**

• Complementary Shaders, Iris Shaders — beautiful shaders

• BetterF3, Jade — convenient information

• Item Borders, Chat Heads — improved interface

**_Efficiency_**

• Sodium, Lithium, Starlight, ImmediatelyFast — maximum FPS

• FerriteCore, Memory Leak Fix — memory optimization

• Dynamic FPS, FPS Reducer — resource consumption control

**_Inventory and convenience_**

• Curios API, Trinkets — slots for accessories

• Elytra Slot — a slot for wings

• Inventory Profiles Next — inventory management

• Carry On, Chat Heads — convenient mechanics
